content: {"episode_id":"ep-05146","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, as not medically necessary. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery, supported by diagnosis codes I25.10 and R00.2. Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease. We request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 552.4 based on this documented indication."}
